biography.value:
Gray dragons are savage, quick to anger and slow to forgive. They decorate their lairs with the statues of those who failed to escape their petrifying breath, and they bite rather than talk.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .zZgofAiAtRrPRmvz]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .1iHu54aFdW9DNfOJ]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .6sYEsAslVeTKEnjm]]{claws}.

Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=mubzAZ82rplpySQK]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=mubzAZ82rplpySQK]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=mubzAZ82rplpySQK]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=z4yZJHrCdsex6o07]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Acid Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a cloud of stinging acid in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=VZBWBN2CGDOUgKWn]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=VZBWBN2CGDOUgKWn]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=VZBWBN2CGDOUgKWn]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Petrifying Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its petrifying Breath in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=fJQVu56GuvpRgjrm]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=fJQVu56GuvpRgjrm]] saving throw or begin to turn to stone and be &Reference[restrained]. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming &Reference[petrified] on a failure or ending the effect on a success.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} scores a critical hit with its Bite on a roll of 19 or 20.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Stone spikes erupt in a 20-foot square: DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing damage.
  • A creature the dragon can see feels its limbs stiffen: DC 15 Constitution saving throw or its speed is 0 until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • One statue in the lair animates and makes one attack (+7 to hit, 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage).
